label: Boolean relay cuts match one feed and infinitely many feeds with the same first position
paraphrase: On the same successor roster with the same selected power, arbitrary maintained feeds admit an all-active intact baseline and responses to every single cut. In every response, receiver zero is active after cut i exactly when some feed is at a position at most i. The sole feed at d and feeds at every n ≥ d give identical Boolean reports for every primary cut. Charging those feed positions individually gives the singleton inventory a headcount advantage surviving every finite addition. A stipulated additive unit-count readout settles whether position i has a feed by whether the reported count rises by one when i enters the measured prefix. The prefix through position d+1 reports one unit for the singleton and two for the tail.
